dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "May the Lord of Geo protect us on our journey to a faraway land, a new home where we can start a life all our own..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...I only hope that our painstaking planning and past mistakes were not all for nothing."
